What to include

The more of this you provide up front, the more useful the reply will be.

  • The product, molecule or excipient, with the grade or pharmacopoeial standard if you have it
  • For excipients, what the material has to do in the formulation
  • Quantity, and whether this is a trial, a one off or a recurring requirement
  • The destination market, since this determines which certification is acceptable
  • Any documentation your regulator or importer has already specified
  • Your timeframe

Technical enquiries are answered by Dr. Qaria directly rather than by a sales desk.
